assignees: INSPUR SUZHOU INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: DISTRIBUTED PAIR WEIGHTED AVERAGING
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to perform distributed weighted-averaging computations for machine-learning models. In at least one embodiment, aligned distributed blocks including value blocks derived from a sequence-alignment representation and weight blocks derived from a pair-representation tensor are used to compute a local weighted-averaging contribution and local normalization information, and a local normalization state and a local output block are updated based on the local weighted-averaging contribution and the local normalization information.
first_claim: 1. One or more processors, comprising: circuitry to: receive, during successive communication steps on a GPU of a two-dimensional GPU mesh, aligned distributed value blocks derived from a sequence-alignment representation and aligned distributed weight blocks derived from a pair-representation tensor, the aligned distributed value blocks and the aligned distributed weight blocks being for the same weighted-averaging computation over a shared sequence-position axis and being distributed according to different sharding arrangements on the two-dimensional GPU mesh; compute, from currently aligned ones of the aligned distributed value blocks and the aligned distributed weight blocks, a local weighted-averaging contribution and local normalization information; update a local normalization state across the successive communication steps based on the local normalization information; and generate a local output block for the weighted-averaging computation based on the local weighted-averaging contribution and the local normalization state.

title: HYBRID SCHEDULING FOR OUT-OF-ORDER PROCESSING
abstract: A processor including reservation stations configured to schedule the execution of instructions of a program is disclosed. The reservations stations may receive instructions from the program based on their type. A first type of reservation station may receive instructions that are processed most efficiently using a dispatch and pick approach that maximizes the capacity of segments in the reservation station. A second type of reservation station receives instructions that are processed most efficiently using a dispatch and pick approach that preserves the program order of the instructions. The reservation stations operate together to provide a hybrid scheduling of the instructions, which can improve processing efficiency.
first_claim: 1. A method for executing a program using a processor, the method comprising: receiving an instruction from the program; decoding the instruction to determine a type of the instruction; determining that the type is sensitive to an order of execution; allocating the instruction to an order-based reservation station of the processor, the order-based reservation station having a plurality of segments; dispatching the instruction to a segment of the plurality of segments according to an order-based dispatch policy of the order-based reservation station; issuing the instruction to an execution unit coupled to the order-based reservation station according to an order-based pick policy of the order-based reservation station; and executing the instruction using the execution unit.

title: Pipeline techniques for dependent graphics kicks
abstract: Disclosed techniques relate to scheduling sets of graphics work with dependencies. In some embodiments, a first set of graphics work depends on a second set of graphics work. Control circuitry may, in response to a release signal that indicates the second set reaching a first processing point, initiate processing of the first set. Control circuitry may, in response to reaching a kick gate point, stall processing of the first set. Control circuitry may, in response to an end signal for the second set, resume processing of the first set.
first_claim: 1. An apparatus, comprising: graphics processor circuitry; and control circuitry configured to: receive a command stream that indicates different sets of graphics work and schedule sets of graphics work for execution on distributed hardware resources, wherein the command stream includes a first set of work and indicates that the first set of work depends on a second set of work and includes a third set of work and indicates that the third set of work depends on a fourth set of work; in response to an early release signal from the second set of work that indicates that all single-instruction multiple-data (SIMD) groups of the second set of work have been launched, initiate processing of the first set of work by the graphics processor circuitry; stall processing of the first set of work in response to reaching a gate point in the first set of work; resume processing of the first set of work in response to an end signal for the second set of work; and in response to a late release signal from the fourth set of work that indicates that all SIMD groups of the fourth set of work have completed but one or more cleanup operations for the fourth set of work are not complete, initiate processing of the third set of work by the graphics processor circuitry.

title: CROSS-SITE ROUTING OF INFERENCE WORKLOADS BASED ON PREDICTED POWER AVAILABILITY
abstract: The disclosure presents a technique for routing discrete AI inference workloads to processor clusters co-located with distinct variable-power sources. This technique includes a workload routing process implemented by a cross-site router with four main components: a long-term planner, a short-term planner, a configurator, and a request scheduler. The long-term planner uses workload arrival patterns and long-term predicted power availability at processing sites to generate a first allocation plan for configuring processor frequency and tensor parallelism, and routing inference workloads. The short-term planner uses the first allocation plan and short-term predicted power availability at processing sites to generate a second allocation plan for adjusting processor frequency and routing inference workloads. The configurator allocates processors at the processor clusters based on the first allocation plan and the second allocation plan. The request scheduler routes workload requests to the processing sites based on workload characteristics and the second allocation plan.
first_claim: 1. A method for routing discrete workloads to processor clusters co-located with distinct variable-power sources comprising: generating a first allocation plan based on one or more workload arrival patterns and long-term predicted power availability on a first, longer timescale from one or more distinct variable-power sources; generating a second allocation plan based on the first allocation plan, the one or more workload arrival patterns, and short-term predicted power availability on a second, shorter timescale from the one or more distinct variable-power sources; and allocating the one or more discrete workloads to one or more processor clusters co-located with one of the distinct variable-power sources based on the second allocation plan.

title: PRESERVING QUALITY OF SERVICE FOR CLIENT APPLICATIONS HAVING WORKLOADS FOR EXECUTION BY A COMPUTE CORE OR A HARDWARE ACCELERATOR
abstract: Systems and methods for preserving the quality of service for client applications having workloads for execution by a compute core or a hardware accelerator are described. A method for operating a hardware accelerator configured to process commands submitted by client applications to the hardware accelerator, where a workload can be executed either by a compute core or by the hardware accelerator, is described. The method includes queueing commands for execution of workloads in a first set of command queues and queueing commands for execution of workloads in a second set of command queues. The method includes workload processors executing workloads specified by commands in the first set of command queues and the second set of command queues in an order of execution that is determined based on output of a set of trackers configured to track one or more criteria for a selected
first_claim: 1-20. (canceled)

title: Device placement optimization with reinforcement learning
abstract: A method for determining a placement for machine learning model operations across multiple hardware devices is described. The method includes receiving data specifying a machine learning model to be placed for distributed processing on multiple hardware devices; generating, from the data, a sequence of operation embeddings, each operation embedding in the sequence characterizing respective operations necessary to perform the processing of the machine learning model; processing the sequence of operation embeddings using a placement recurrent neural network in accordance with first values of a plurality network parameters of the placement recurrent neural network to generate a network output that defines a placement of the operations characterized by the operation embeddings in the sequence across the plurality of devices; and scheduling the machine learning model for processing by the multiple hardware devices by placing the operations on the multiple devices according to the placement defined by the network output.
first_claim: 1. A computer-implemented method comprising: receiving data specifying a computational graph that represents a plurality of operations to be placed for distributed processing on a plurality of hardware devices; generating, from the data specifying the computational graph, a sequence of operation embeddings, wherein each operation embedding in the sequence characterizes one or more respective operations of the plurality of operations; processing the sequence of operation embeddings using a placement neural network in accordance with first values of a plurality network parameters of the placement neural network, wherein the placement neural network has an encoder-decoder architecture and is configured to process the sequence of operation embeddings in accordance with the first values to generate a network output defining a placement of the operations characterized by the operation embeddings in the sequence across the plurality of devices; and scheduling the plurality of operations for processing by the plurality of hardware devices by placing the operations on the plurality of devices according to the placement defined by the network output.

title: Image enhancement via iterative refinement based on machine learning models
abstract: A method includes receiving, by a computing device, training data comprising a plurality of pairs of images, wherein each pair comprises an image and at least one corresponding target version of the image. The method also includes training a neural network based on the training data to predict an enhanced version of an input image, wherein the training of the neural network comprises applying a forward Gaussian diffusion process that adds Gaussian noise to the at least one corresponding target version of each of the plurality of pairs of images to enable iterative denoising of the input image, wherein the iterative denoising is based on a reverse Markov chain associated with the forward Gaussian diffusion process. The method additionally includes outputting the trained neural network.
first_claim: 1. A computer-implemented method, comprising: receiving training data from an image database; training, based on the training data, a neural network to predict a high-resolution version of a low-resolution input image, wherein the training comprises denoising score matching to train one or more non-normalized energy functions for density estimation, and wherein the neural network is trained based on a diffusion process comprising: an image corruption process that iteratively adds noise to a high-resolution image, and an image denoising process that learns to reverse the image corruption process by starting from an initial noisy image and iteratively removing noise from the initial image to achieve a target distribution; and providing the trained neural network.

title: Multi-task adapter neural networks
abstract: A system including a multi-task adapter neural network for performing multiple machine learning tasks is described. The adapter neural network is configured to receive a shared input for the machine learning tasks, and process the shared input to generate, for each of the machine learning tasks, a respective predicted output. The adapter neural network includes (i) a shared encoder configured to receive the shared input and to process the shared input to extract shared feature representations for the machine learning tasks, and (ii) multiple task-adapter encoders, each of the task-adapter encoders being associated with a respective machine learning task in the machine learning tasks and configured to: receive the shared input, receive the shared feature representations from the shared encoder, and process the shared input and the shared feature representations to generate the respective predicted output for the respective machine learning task.
first_claim: 1. A system comprising: one or more storage devices; and one or more processors storing instructions that, when executed by the one or more processors, cause the one or more processors to implement a multi-task adapter neural network for performing a plurality of machine learning tasks, wherein the multi-task adapter neural network is configured to: receive a shared input for the plurality of machine learning tasks, and process the shared input to generate, for each of the plurality of machine learning tasks, a respective predicted output; wherein the multi-task adapter neural network comprises: a shared encoder configured to: receive the shared input, and process the shared input to extract shared feature representations for the plurality of machine learning tasks; and a plurality of task-adapter encoders, wherein each of the plurality of task-adapter encoders is associated with a respective machine learning task in the plurality of machine learning tasks and is configured to: receive the shared input, receive the shared feature representations from the shared encoder, and process the shared input and the shared feature representations to generate the respective predicted output for the respective machine learning task, wherein layers of the plurality of task-adapter encoders are arranged in parallel with corresponding layers of the shared encoder, and wherein at least one layer of each task-adapter encoder is configured to receive as input a combination of (i) an output of a layer preceding the corresponding layer of the shared encoder and (ii) an output of a previous layer of the task-adapter encoder.

title: Machine learning methods and apparatus related to predicting motion(s) of object(s) in a robot's environment based on image(s) capturing the object(s) and based on parameter(s) for future robot movement in the environment
abstract: Some implementations of this specification are directed generally to deep machine learning methods and apparatus related to predicting motion(s) (if any) that will occur to object(s) in an environment of a robot in response to particular movement of the robot in the environment. Some implementations are directed to training a deep neural network model to predict at least one transformation (if any), of an image of a robot's environment, that will occur as a result of implementing at least a portion of a particular movement of the robot in the environment. The trained deep neural network model may predict the transformation based on input that includes the image and a group of robot movement parameters that define the portion of the particular movement.
first_claim: 1. A method implemented by one or more processors, comprising: generating candidate robot movement parameters, the candidate robot movement parameters defining at least a portion of a candidate movement performable in an environment of a robot by one or more components of the robot; identifying a current image captured by a vision sensor associated with the robot, the current image capturing at least a portion of the environment of the robot; applying the current image and the candidate robot movement parameters as input to a trained neural network; generating at least one predicted transformation of the current image, the predicted transformation indicating pixel motion predictions and being generated based on the application of the current image and the candidate robot movement parameters to the trained neural network; transforming the current image to generate at least one predicted image, wherein transforming the current image comprises applying, to the current image, the at least one predicted transformation generated based on the application of the current image and the candidate robot movement parameters to the trained neural network, the predicted image predicting the portion of the environment of the robot were the at least the portion of the candidate movement performed in the environment by the components of the robot; determining, based on the predicted image, to perform a second candidate movement in lieu of the candidate movement; generating second candidate robot movement parameters, the second candidate robot movement parameters defining at least a portion of the second candidate movement; applying the current image and the second candidate robot movement parameters as input to the trained neural network; generating at least one second predicted transformation of the current image, the second predicted transformation being generated based on the application of the current image and the second candidate robot movement parameters to the trained neural network; transforming one or more pixels of the current image based on the second predicted transformation to generate at least one second predicted image, the second predicted image predicting the portion of the environment of the robot if the at least the portion of the second candidate movement is performed in the environment by the components of the robot; selecting the second candidate movement based on the second predicted image; and providing one or more control commands to one or more actuators of the robot to perform the second candidate movement.

title: KEY VALUE AND EXTENDED TENSOR PARALLELISM FOR TRANSFORMER-BASED NEURAL NETWORKS
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to generate inferences for input data. In at least one embodiment, inferences based on input data and using one or more neural networks that include a transformer, with Key-Value (KV) attention heads and partitions of a KV cache of context data of the transformer distributed to different processors. Attention values may be computed for the input data using the distributed KV attention heads and partitions of the KV cache at the different processors. The attention values may be exchanged between the different processors. An output of the transformer may be computed at the different processors using different weight partitions of a Feedforward Network (FFN) of the transformer that are different with respect to the distributed KV attention heads.
first_claim: 1. A processor comprising: a plurality of circuits to generate one or more inferences based on input data and using one or more neural networks comprising a transformer, wherein Key-Value (KV) attention heads and partitions of a KV cache of context data of the transformer are distributed to different ones of the plurality of circuits, and the one or more neural networks are to: compute attention values for the input data using the distributed KV attention heads and partitions of the KV cache at the different ones of the plurality of circuits; exchange the attention values between the plurality of different circuits; and compute an output of the transformer at different ones of the plurality of circuits using different weight partitions of a Feedforward Network (FFN) of the transformer that are different with respect to the distributed KV attention heads.

title: HYBRID DATA PARALLELISM FOR TRANSFORMER-BASED NEURAL NETWORKS
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to generate inferences for a batch of input data. In at least one embodiment, inferences for a batch of input data may be generated using one or more neural networks that includes a transformer, where the transformer distributes batch partitions of the batch of input data and Key-Value (KV) attention head partitions that use a KV cache of context data for the inferences to different ones of the processors, computes attention values of the batch partitions with respective to the KV attention head partitions at the different ones of the processors, exchanges two or more of the attention values between the different processors, and computes an output of the transformer at different ones of the processors using different weight partitions of a Feed-forward Network (FFN).
first_claim: 1. A processor comprising: one or more circuits to generate inferences for a batch of input data using one or more neural networks comprising a transformer, wherein the transformer: receives a batch partition of the batch of input data to compute attention values for a Key-Value (KV) attention head partition that uses a KV cache of context data for the inferences, wherein the batch of input data is distributed across a plurality of processors, including the processor, and wherein the KV attention head partition is one of a plurality of KV attention head partitions distributed to the different ones of the plurality of processors; computes attention values of the batch partition with respective to the KV attention head partition at the different ones of the plurality of processors; exchanges two or more of the attention values with other ones of the plurality of different processors; and computes an output based, at least in part, on the exchanged two or more attention values.

title: Artificial intelligence satellite module
abstract: An artificial intelligence (AI) satellite module is described. The satellite module includes a solar panel having a first side that includes multiple solar cells and a second side that includes a power delivery network that distributes power signals generated by the solar cells. The satellite module includes at least one machine-learning (“ML”) hardware accelerator adjacent to the solar panel. The ML accelerator is configured to implement an ML model (e.g., a neural network ML model). The satellite module includes a heat dissipation layer configured to radiate heat generated when the ML hardware accelerator is powered by the solar panel. The heat dissipation layer includes one or more heat pipes that: i) are coupled to the ML hardware accelerator, and ii) dissipate heat generated when the ML hardware accelerator executes a training or inference workload of the ML model.
first_claim: 1. A satellite module comprising: a solar panel comprising: i) a first side that includes a plurality of solar cells; and ii) a second side that includes a power delivery network configured to distribute power signals generated by the plurality of solar cells; at least one machine-learning (“ML”) hardware accelerator adjacent the solar panel, the at least one ML hardware accelerator configured to implement a neural network ML model; and a heat dissipation layer configured to radiate heat generated when the at least one ML hardware accelerator is powered by the power signals, wherein the heat dissipation layer comprises a plurality of heat pipes that are coupled to the at least one ML hardware accelerator and are configured to dissipate heat generated when the at least one ML hardware accelerator executes a training or inference workload of the neural network ML model.

title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE SATELLITE MODULE
abstract: An artificial intelligence (AI) satellite module is described. The satellite module includes a solar panel having a first side that includes multiple solar cells and a second side that includes a power delivery network that distributes power signals generated by the solar cells. The satellite module includes at least one machine-learning (“ML”) hardware accelerator adjacent to the solar panel. The ML hardware accelerator is configured to implement an ML model (e.g., a neural network ML model). The satellite module includes a heat dissipation layer configured to radiate heat generated when the ML hardware accelerator is powered by the solar panel. The heat dissipation layer includes one or more heat pipes that: i) are coupled to the ML hardware accelerator, and ii) dissipate heat generated when the ML hardware accelerator executes a training or inference workload of the ML model.
first_claim: 1. A satellite module comprising: a solar panel comprising: i) a first side that includes a plurality of solar cells; and ii) a second side that includes a power delivery network configured to distribute power signals generated by the plurality of solar cells; at least one machine-learning (“ML”) hardware accelerator adjacent the solar panel, the at least one ML hardware accelerator configured to implement a neural network ML model; and a heat dissipation layer configured to radiate heat generated when the at least one ML hardware accelerator is powered by the power signals, wherein the heat dissipation layer comprises a plurality of heat pipes that are coupled to the at least one ML hardware accelerator and are configured to dissipate heat generated when the at least one ML hardware accelerator executes a training or inference workload of the neural network ML model.

title: Multi-modal neural network architecture search
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for searching for an architecture for a neural network that performs a multi-modal task that requires operating on inputs that each include data from multiple different modalities.
first_claim: 1. A method comprising: receiving training data for training a neural network to perform a multi-modal machine learning task, the training data comprising a plurality of training examples and a respective target output for each of the training examples, wherein each training example comprises a respective network input from each of a plurality of modalities; and determining, using the training data, an optimized neural network architecture for performing the machine learning task, comprising: generating a plurality of candidate neural network architectures, wherein: each candidate neural network architecture comprises a plurality of operation blocks that each receive a respective block input comprising at least a respective first input hidden state and a respective second hidden state and apply one or more operations to the block input to generate an output hidden state, and generating each of the plurality of candidate neural network architectures comprises, for each of the operation blocks in the candidate neural network architecture: selecting, for each of the plurality of operation blocks, each of the first and second hidden states that are received as input by the operation block from a respective set of possible inputs that includes at least each of the respective network inputs from each of the plurality of modalities, wherein each candidate neural network architecture (i) generates an output state that is a combination of a respective output state for each of the plurality of modalities and (ii) processes at least the output state using one or more neural network layers to generate a final output for the multi-modal machine learning task, and wherein the respective output state for each of the plurality of modalities is generated from output hidden states that are both (i) not used in a block input for any of the plurality of operation blocks and (ii) conditioned on the respective network input from the modality; determining, for each candidate network architecture, a respective fitness on the multi-modal machine learning task; and selecting, from the candidate neural network architectures, the optimized neural network architecture based on the respective fitnesses.

title: INFERENCE ON MEMORY-CONSTRAINED SYSTEMS
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to perform neural networks. For example, one or more processors cause a second portion of a neural network to be loaded into memory concurrently with inference performed using a first portion of the neural network; and cause the loaded second portion to be used to perform inference using output of the first portion of the neural network.
first_claim: 1. One or more processors, comprising circuitry to: cause a second portion of a neural network to be loaded into memory concurrently with inferencing performed using a first portion of the neural network; and cause the loaded second portion to be used to perform inferencing using output of the first portion of the neural network.

title: Low-Rank Adaptation of Neural Network Models
abstract: A computer implemented method obtains neural network-based model base model weight matrices for each of multiple neural network layers. First low-rank factorization matrices are added to corresponding base model weight matrices to form a first domain model. The low-rank factorization matrices are treated as trainable parameters. The first domain model is trained with first domain specific training data without modifying base model weight matrices.
first_claim: 1. A computer-implemented method comprising: accessing a transformer-based, general-domain-trained language model having a plurality of layers, each layer comprising a frozen base weight matrix of dimension d; obtaining, for each layer, a pair of low-rank adaptation matrices previously trained on domain-specific data to adapt the language model, the pair having an intermediate dimension r less than d; merging each frozen base weight matrix with a product of its corresponding pair to form an adapted weight matrix; and performing inference on domain input using the adapted weight matrices.

title: Multi-Stage Training Process for Sequence Models
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a two-stage training process for machine-learned models, particularly large language models (LLMs), to balance user satisfaction and third-party content presentation. In the first stage, a reward model is trained using reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) to predict user satisfaction with outputs including third-party content. The second stage involves training a machine-learned model using a loss function that combines the user satisfaction metric from the reward model with predicted interaction metrics for the third-party content. The trained model generates natural language output incorporating third-party content. This approach can be used in AI assistants and search engines.
first_claim: 1. A computer-implemented method comprising: training a reward model using reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) to predict user satisfaction metric associated with a first output comprising a third-party content item, wherein the first output is generated by the reward model based on a prompt comprising: (i) a user query and (ii) one or more third-party content items; training a second machine-learned model using a loss function, wherein the loss function is based on a combination of: (i) a user satisfaction metric generated by the trained reward model and (iii) predicted interaction metrics for a third-party content item integrated into second output of the second machine-learned model, wherein the second output is generated by the second machine-learned model based on the user query; and processing, by the trained second machine-learned model, a second user query to generate third output comprising a combination of (i) natural language output and (ii) one or more third party content items.

title: Processing images using self-attention based neural networks
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for processing images using self-attention based neural networks. One of the methods includes obtaining one or more images comprising a plurality of pixels; determining, for each image of the one or more images, a plurality of image patches of the image, wherein each image patch comprises a different subset of the pixels of the image; processing, for each image of the one or more images, the corresponding plurality of image patches to generate an input sequence comprising a respective input element at each of a plurality of input positions, wherein a plurality of the input elements correspond to respective different image patches; and processing the input sequences using a neural network to generate a network output that characterizes the one or more images, wherein the neural network comprises one or more self-attention neural network layers.
first_claim: 1. A method performed by one or more computers, the method comprising: obtaining training data for a first machine learning task, the training data comprising a plurality of first training images; training a base neural network on the training data for the first machine learning task, wherein the base neural network comprises (i) a self-attention based subnetwork that comprises one or more self-attention neural network layers and (ii) a base head subnetwork, and wherein the base neural network is configured to, for each of the first training images: determine a plurality of image patches of the first training image, wherein each image patch comprises a different subset of the pixels of the first training image; process the plurality of image patches to generate an input sequence comprising a respective input element at each of a plurality of input positions, wherein a plurality of the input elements correspond to respective different image patches; process the input sequence using the self-attention based subnetwork to generate a respective output element for each input element in the input sequence; and process one or more of the output elements using the base head subnetwork to generate a network output for the first machine learning task; obtaining training data for a second machine learning task, the training data comprising a plurality of second training images; and training a task neural network on the training data for the second machine learning task, wherein the task neural network comprises (i) the self-attention based subnetwork that comprises one or more self-attention neural network layers and (ii) and a task head subnetwork.

title: Reducing computational resource usage via training and/or utilizing large language models
abstract: Implementations described herein relate to using self-evaluation when utilizing a large language model (LLM) to generate a response to a natural language (NL) based input. The LLM can be used to process the NL based input to generate a plurality of responses, and to generate a critique of those responses by comparing the responses to a set of response evaluation criteria. One of the responses can then be selected based on the comparison with the set of response evaluation criteria which can vary from one NL based input to another. If the NL based input was obtained a user of a client device during an inference stage, then the selected response can be rendered for presentation to the user. If the NL based input was obtained during a training stage, then the selected response can be stored as a training instance and optionally in association with additional data.
first_claim: 1. A method implemented by one or more processors, the method comprising: receiving natural language (NL) based input associated with a client device; generating, using a large language model (LLM), an LLM response based on processing the NL based input, wherein generating the LLM response comprises: obtaining a set of response evaluation criteria for evaluating a plurality of candidate LLM responses, wherein obtaining the set of response evaluation criteria for evaluating the plurality of candidate LLM responses comprises: generating a request for the LLM to generate the set of response evaluation criteria based on the NL based input; and processing the request to generate the set of response evaluation criteria; generating the plurality of candidate LLM responses based on processing the NL based input; generating, for each of the plurality of candidate LLM responses, a corresponding critique response based on processing each of the plurality of candidate LLM responses and the set of response evaluation criteria using the LLM, wherein each of the corresponding critique responses are indicative of an extent to which a respective one of the plurality of candidate LLM responses complies with the set of response evaluation criteria, and wherein generating the corresponding critique response for a given candidate LLM response comprises: generating a request for the LLM to determine which of the set of response evaluation criteria the given candidate LLM response complies with; and processing the request using the LLM to generate the corresponding critique response; and selecting, based on the corresponding critique response associated with one of the plurality of candidate LLM responses indicating a threshold compliance with the set of response evaluation criteria, the one of the plurality of candidate LLM responses as the LLM response; and causing the LLM response to be rendered at the client device.

title: Pruning neural networks
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to remove one or more nodes of a neural network. In at least one embodiment, one or more nodes of a neural network are removed, based on, for example, whether the one or more nodes are likely to affect performance of the neural network.
first_claim: 1. A processor, comprising: one or more circuits to: identify a sub-network of a neural network by at least: calculating a set of importance scores for a plurality of nodes of the neural network; and determining that importance scores for a plurality of nodes of a sub-network of the neural network satisfies one or more criteria; calculate, for the sub-network of the neural network, a stability value that indicates a measure of potential change to parameters of the plurality of nodes of the sub-network as a result of one or more subsequent training epochs for the neural network; determine to perform early pruning of the neural network before completing the one or more subsequent training epochs for the neural network based, at least in part, on a determination that the stability value of the sub-network is above a pre-defined threshold; and remove one or more nodes of the neural network based, at least in part, on respective importance scores of the one or more nodes of the neural network to perform the early pruning of the neural network before completing the one or more subsequent training epochs for the neural network.
